description: A typical steel dagger. While easy to use, it is only truly deadly in the hands of a skilled fighter. Indeed, many weapons require honed skills to unlock their true potential.
name: Dagger

description: A straight one-handed sword, with a single edge and a basket hilt. Capable of cutting and thrusting at equal measures. Long gone are the arming swords of old, replaced as they are by these well-balanced modern tools. However, versatility can sometimes only be gained at the sacrifice of a more effective specialization.
name: Backsword

description: A long, heavy double-edged sword. Unlike older one-handed swords, these great two-handed blades have survived nearly unchanged for centuries. Considering the manner in which they combine the power of an axe, the thrusts and reach of a spear, and the versatility of a sword, it's easy to see why. The only real drawback is the skill required to wield such a multifaceted beast.
name: Two-Handed Sword

description: A bludgeon on a chain. Poor for parrying, but can make it difficult for enemies to do the same.
name: Flail

description: A long rod ended in a heavy flail. Can deliver crushing blows.
name: Two-Handed Flail

description: A weapon that is simple to use for how well it hacks into enemies. Unfortunatley, heavily armored foes will have a particularly easy time resisting an axe's strike. For them, the reverse hook should be applied judiciously.
name: Battle Axe

description: A polearm with an a heavy axe head, able to deliver brutal chops with ease. Even armored foes will be wary of these cleaving blows, but the long reach and reverse hook can be used should one need to pull them off their feet.
name: Two-Handed Axe

description: A short war bow. Its composite construction and recurve design afford a shocking amount of power for its size. A common choice for horseback archers.
name: Short Bow

description: A spear with two smaller bladed flanges at the base of the central blade. As with most spears, its basic thrusting ability is simple enough for anyone to utilize. Indeed, the spear traces its roots back to before the dawn of civilization. It could very well symbolize our collective spirit.
name: Spontoon

description: A simple wooden bludgeon. One of civilization's earliest inventions. As well it should be, as a blunt strike is useful against almost any obstacle.
name: Wooden Club

description: A wooden bludgen built large, for greater striking force at the cost of requiring two hands. When selecting armaments, two handed weapons are the choice for those who are heavily armored and don't need a shield. Or are simply of a reckless disposition.
name: Two-Handed Club

description: A moderately sized wooden shield. Even well-crafted shields tend to be made of wood, as a thick portion of it is effective against all sorts of hazards. A shield of solid metal wouldn't be any more effective, and generally isn't worth the resources required to craft.
name: Wooden Shield

description: A fairly standard pump-action shotgun with a shortened barrel. Easy to carry, and useful for the kinds of ranges encountered in urban environments.
name: Riot Shotgun

description: A common 9mm handgun. It's concealable and easy to carry, if somewhat lacking in stopping power.
name: Handgun

description: A fully automatic weapon that fires 9mm handgun rounds. It's high rate of fire makes up for the low power of individual shots.
name: SMG

description: A fairly hefty knife, designed for both utility and fighting.
name: Combat Knife

description: A combat stick with a perpendicular handle. Used by police and martial artists alike.
name: Tonfa

description: Worn over the fingers, these make punches hit a lot harder!
name: Brass Knuckles
